verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev explicitly supports sending external signals into a running workflow via waitpoint tokens (pause task runs until you complete the token, used for approval workflows and scenarios needing external confirmation) and via tool-call approval gating (needsApproval: true pauses for human approval while the run stays alive). The management API (runs.list, cancel/retry via handle) further lets external code or webhooks interact with running tasks, and realtime streaming supports bidirectional external interaction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of waitpoint-token/external-signal usage, since older community comments even list wait/resume as a wish-list gap, suggesting limited real-world validation of this newer feature.
